title: GroundAnything: Reconciling Parallel Decoding with Precise Visual Grounding at Flash Speed
title_zh: GroundAnything：在闪电速度下协调并行解码与精确视觉定位

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive (AR) grounding models serialize spatial predictions, introducing sequential latency and imposing a causal order on output tokens. We view grounding as visual evidence extraction: objects, locations, and spatial relations are jointly constrained by the image and query, yet their dependencies do not imply an intrinsic left-to-right generation order. This distinction makes bidirectional diffusion a natural fit, allowing spatial hypotheses to emerge in parallel and be jointly refined through iterative denoising. We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model that reconciles fast parallel decoding with precise localization through blockwise denoising. Training combines grounding pretraining from public datasets and dedicated data engines, direct AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint AR and diffusion objectives, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement post-training. Across 30 grounding benchmarks, our autoregressive variant, GroundAnything-VLM, establishes a new overall state of the art among similarly sized models at 72.42%, remaining competitive with GPT-6 Astra (71.35%). With entropy-guided decoding, GroundAnything also surpasses the prior state of the art at this scale, averaging 61.75% versus 53.32% for the fast MTP-based LocateAnything model. We further explore decoding strategies, showing that an optional self-speculative mode achieves a 4.51 × \times speedup over the AR counterpart with a 0.74 percentage-point drop in COCO F1mIoU. Infrastructure experiments show that progressive inference optimizations translate parallel decoding into practical speedups. These support efficient visual grounding in latency-sensitive real-world systems.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归（AR）基础模型将空间预测序列化，从而引入序列延迟，并对输出标记施加因果顺序。 我们将基础建模视为视觉证据提取：物体、位置和空间关系由图像和查询共同约束，但它们的依赖关系并不意味着内在的从左到右生成顺序。 这种区别使得双向扩散成为自然的选择，它允许空间假设并行出现，并通过迭代去噪过程进行联合优化。 我们提出了 GroundAnything，这是一个拥有 40 亿参数的基础模型，通过分块去噪实现了快速并行解码与精确定位之间的平衡。 训练过程结合了来自公开数据集和专用数据引擎的基础预训练、自回归到扩散的直接转换与联合自回归及扩散目标、有监督微调以及基于 GRPO 的强化后训练。 在 30 个基础建模基准测试中，我们的自回归版本 GroundAnything-VLM 在同类规模模型中取得了 72.42% 的新整体最佳性能，并与 GPT-6 Astra（71.35%）保持竞争力。 借助熵引导解码，GroundAnything 在该规模上也超越了此前的最佳模型，平均准确率为 61.75%，而基于快速 MTP 的 LocateAnything 模型仅为 53.32%。 我们进一步探索了解码策略，结果表明，可选的自我推测模式相比自回归版本实现了 4.51 倍的速度提升，同时 COCO F1mIoU 仅下降 0.74 个百分点。 基础设施实验表明，渐进式推理优化能够将并行解码转化为实际的速度提升。 这些成果支持在延迟敏感的真实世界系统中实现高效的视觉基础建模。

paragraphs.en: Visual grounding turns visual inputs into structured spatial predictions across object detection, referring expression comprehension, OCR, GUI interaction, and embodied perception. Next-token prediction has become a mainstream paradigm for generative grounding, with models such as Pix2Seq, Florence-2, and Rex-Omni expressing visual predictions as structured token sequences ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ) . However, autoregressive (AR) decoding serializes labels and coordinates, introducing sequential latency and restricting output interactions to the generated prefix ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) . These limitations are particularly costly in dense scenes and complex layouts.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉接地将视觉输入转化为结构化的空间预测，涵盖目标检测、指代表达理解、OCR、GUI交互和具身感知。 下一词预测已成为生成式接地的主流范式，例如 Pix2Seq、Florence-2 和 Rex-Omni 等模型将视觉预测表示为结构化的词元序列（Jiang et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2022；Xiao et al., 2024）。 然而，自回归（AR）解码会将标签和坐标序列化，从而引入顺序延迟，并将输出交互限制在已生成的前缀内（Chen et al., 2022；Cheng et al., 2024）。 这些局限性在密集场景和复杂布局中尤为代价高昂。

paragraphs.en: To reduce AR decoding latency, LocateAnything uses multi-token prediction (MTP) for parallel box decoding ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Diffusion VLMs support parallel generation and bidirectional refinement, with advances in multimodal understanding ( You et al., 2026b ; Wu et al., 2026a ) , GUI grounding ( Kumbhar et al., 2026 ) , and document OCR ( Dong et al., 2026 ) . Yet these grounding applications remain domain-specific, leaving diffusion’s broader potential for unified structured prediction across diverse visual tasks largely untapped.
paragraphs.zh: 为降低 AR 解码延迟，LocateAnything 采用多标记预测（MTP）实现并行框解码（Wang 等，2026）。 扩散 VLM 支持并行生成和双向优化，并在多模态理解（You 等，2026b；Wu 等，2026a）、GUI 定位（Kumbhar 等，2026）和文档 OCR（Dong 等，2026）方面取得进展。 然而，这些定位应用仍局限于特定领域，导致扩散模型在多样化视觉任务中实现统一结构化预测的更广泛潜力尚未得到充分挖掘。

sents.zh: 然而，这些定位应用仍局限于特定领域，导致扩散模型在多样化视觉任务中实现统一结构化预测的更广泛潜力尚未得到充分挖掘。

paragraphs.en: To unlock this potential and reconcile fast parallel decoding with broad and precise visual grounding, we start from a familiar observation: we may notice objects or read separate signs in different orders, yet reach the same judgment about what is present and where. We therefore view grounding as structured visual evidence extraction: spatial variables are jointly constrained by the image and query, without an intrinsic left-to-right generation order. Bidirectional masked diffusion naturally supports this process, allowing hypotheses to emerge in parallel and be refined using shared visual evidence and partially recovered structure ( ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了释放这种潜力，并将快速并行解码与广泛而精确的视觉定位协调起来，我们从一项熟悉的观察出发：我们可能会以不同的顺序注意到物体或阅读独立的标志，但最终对“存在什么以及它们位于何处”得出相同的判断。 因此，我们将视觉定位视为结构化视觉证据的提取过程：空间变量由图像和查询共同约束，而不存在内在的从左到右的生成顺序。 双向掩码扩散模型天然支持这一过程，它允许假设并行出现，并通过共享的视觉证据和部分恢复的结构（ ）进行优化。

paragraphs.en: We introduce GroundAnything , a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model combining broad perceptual capabilities with blockwise parallel decoding. A shared vocabulary with quantized coordinates unifies diverse grounding tasks. Its decoder combines bidirectional attention within blocks with causal dependencies across blocks, enabling parallel prediction and KV-cache reuse ( Arriola et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 GroundAnything，这是一个拥有 40 亿参数的定位基础模型，它将广泛的感知能力与分块并行解码相结合。 一个包含量化坐标的共享词汇表统一了各种定位任务。 其解码器将块内的双向注意力与跨块的因果依赖相结合，从而实现并行预测和 KV 缓存重用（Arriola 等人，2025）。

sents.en: Its decoder combines bidirectional attention within blocks with causal dependencies across blocks, enabling parallel prediction and KV-cache reuse ( Arriola et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 其解码器将块内的双向注意力与跨块的因果依赖相结合，从而实现并行预测和 KV 缓存重用（Arriola 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Grounding pretraining draws on public datasets and dedicated data engines. We build GroundAnything-VLM and GroundAnything from a shared pretrained checkpoint, applying AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint AR and diffusion objectives to the latter. Both variants then undergo supervised fine-tuning and GRPO-based reinforcement post-training.
paragraphs.zh: 基础预训练利用公开数据集和专用数据引擎。 我们从共享的预训练检查点构建 GroundAnything-VLM 和 GroundAnything，并对后者应用 AR 到扩散的转换，同时结合 AR 和扩散目标。 随后，两种变体都会经历监督微调以及基于 GRPO 的强化后训练。

paragraphs.en: Across 30 grounding benchmarks, GroundAnything-VLM establishes a new overall state of the art among similarly sized models at 72.42%, remaining competitive with GPT-6 Astra (71.35%). With entropy-guided decoding, GroundAnything is, to our knowledge, the first diffusion language model to surpass the prior overall AR state of the art at this scale, averaging 61.75% at over 2 × \times the speed of GroundAnything-VLM. We use this mode throughout the main benchmarks to evaluate pure diffusion decoding without AR verification. Additional ablations examine key model and training design choices.
paragraphs.zh: 在 30 项基准测试中，GroundAnything-VLM 在同类规模模型中取得了 72.42% 的新整体最佳性能，并与 GPT-6 Astra（71.35%）保持竞争力。 通过熵引导解码，据我们所知，GroundAnything 是首个在此规模上超越此前整体 AR 最佳性能的扩散语言模型，平均达到 61.75%，速度是 GroundAnything-VLM 的 2 × \times 以上。 我们在主要基准测试中始终使用此模式，以评估纯扩散解码而不进行 AR 验证的表现。 额外的消融研究进一步检验了关键模型设计和训练设计的决策。

paragraphs.en: We further conduct a systematic speed analysis of decoding strategies and their trade-offs, including comparisons with MTP-based generation ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . An optional self-speculative mode combines diffusion drafting with AR verification and improves both speed and accuracy over entropy-guided decoding on COCO, achieving a 4.51 × \times speedup over GroundAnything-VLM with only a 0.74 pp F1mIoU drop. Systematic infrastructure experiments with SGLang, CUDA Graph, and FP8 demonstrate further practical speedups through progressive inference optimizations, supporting efficient visual grounding in real-world applications.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还对解码策略及其权衡进行了系统性的速度分析，包括与基于 MTP 的生成方法（Wang et al., 2026）的比较。 一种可选的自我推测模式将扩散草稿生成与 AR 验证相结合，在 COCO 数据集上相比熵引导解码同时提升了速度和准确性，与 GroundAnything-VLM 相比速度提升了 4.51 × \times，而 F1mIoU 仅下降了 0.74 pp。 使用 SGLang、CUDA Graph 和 FP8 进行的系统性基础设施实验表明，通过渐进式推理优化可以实现进一步的实用速度提升，从而支持在真实世界应用中的高效视觉定位。

paragraphs.en: Unlocking diffusion for broad visual grounding. We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B foundation model that unifies diverse grounding tasks with precise localization and parallel decoding, trained through grounding pretraining, AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint objectives, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement learning.

sents.en: We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B foundation model that unifies diverse grounding tasks with precise localization and parallel decoding, trained through grounding pretraining, AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint objectives, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement learning.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 GroundAnything，这是一个 4B 基础模型，它将多种定位任务与精确的局部化和并行解码相结合，并通过定位预训练、联合目标下的 AR 到扩散转换、监督微调以及基于 GRPO 的强化学习进行训练。

paragraphs.en: State-of-the-art grounding at 4B scale. Across 30 benchmarks, GroundAnything surpasses the prior overall state of the art among similarly sized AR models and outperforms the larger Qwen3.7-Max. GroundAnything-VLM establishes a new overall state of the art at this scale and remains competitive with GPT-6 Astra.
paragraphs.zh: 在 4B 规模上实现业界领先的 grounding 能力。 在 30 项基准测试中，GroundAnything 超越了同规模 AR 模型此前的整体最佳水平，并优于更大规模的 Qwen3.7-Max。 GroundAnything-VLM 在此规模上树立了新的整体最佳水平，并且与 GPT-6 Astra 相比仍具有竞争力。

sents.en: State-of-the-art grounding at 4B scale.
sents.zh: 在 4B 规模上实现业界领先的 grounding 能力。

sents.en: Across 30 benchmarks, GroundAnything surpasses the prior overall state of the art among similarly sized AR models and outperforms the larger Qwen3.7-Max.
sents.zh: 在 30 项基准测试中，GroundAnything 超越了同规模 AR 模型此前的整体最佳水平，并优于更大规模的 Qwen3.7-Max。

sents.en: GroundAnything-VLM establishes a new overall state of the art at this scale and remains competitive with GPT-6 Astra.
sents.zh: GroundAnything-VLM 在此规模上树立了新的整体最佳水平，并且与 GPT-6 Astra 相比仍具有竞争力。

paragraphs.en: Systematic acceleration studies. We analyze decoding strategies in detail, compare with MTP-based generation, and evaluate progressive infrastructure optimizations for practical deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 系统性加速研究。 我们详细分析了解码策略，与基于 MTP 的生成方法进行了比较，并评估了渐进式基础设施优化在实践部署中的效果。

sents.en: Systematic acceleration studies.
sents.zh: 系统性加速研究。

sents.en: We analyze decoding strategies in detail, compare with MTP-based generation, and evaluate progressive infrastructure optimizations for practical deployment.
sents.zh: 我们详细分析了解码策略，与基于 MTP 的生成方法进行了比较，并评估了渐进式基础设施优化在实践部署中的效果。

paragraphs.en: Object detectors such as YOLO establish efficient localization within predefined category vocabularies ( Redmon et al., 2016 ) . Grounded vision–language pretraining extends detection to language-conditioned, open-set localization ( Li et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . Generative approaches formulate detection as autoregressive next-token prediction ( Chen et al., 2022 ) and integrate spatial grounding into multimodal language modeling ( Peng et al., 2023 ) . Structured generation unifies diverse perception tasks ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) , while quantized coordinates, large-scale grounding data, and reinforcement post-training strengthen localization ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . However, AR generation serializes spatial predictions, increasing decoding costs for dense outputs. MTP-based parallel box decoding reduces this overhead by treating boxes and points as atomic generation units ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . This progression motivates exploring alternative parallel generation mechanisms for broad and precise grounding.
paragraphs.zh: YOLO 等目标检测器在预定义的类别词汇表内实现了高效的定位（Redmon 等人，2016）。 基于视觉-语言的基础预训练将检测扩展到了受语言条件约束的开放集定位（Li 等人，2022；Liu 等人，2024）。 生成方法将检测问题表述为自回归的下一个词元预测（Chen 等人，2022），并将空间基础信息整合到多模态语言建模中（Peng 等人，2023）。 结构化生成统一了多种感知任务（Xiao 等人，2024），而量化坐标、大规模基础数据以及强化后训练则增强了定位能力（Jiang 等人，2026）。 然而，自回归生成会将空间预测序列化，从而增加了密集输出时的解码成本。 基于 MTP 的并行框解码通过将框和点视为原子生成单元，降低了这一额外开销（Wang 等人，2026）。 这一发展过程促使我们探索替代性的并行生成机制，以实现广泛且精确的基础定位。

sents.en: This progression motivates exploring alternative parallel generation mechanisms for broad and precise grounding.
sents.zh: 这一发展过程促使我们探索替代性的并行生成机制，以实现广泛且精确的基础定位。

paragraphs.en: Masked diffusion offers a complementary route to parallel generation through bidirectional conditioning and iterative token recovery. Diffusion VLMs demonstrate its potential for visual instruction following and multimodal understanding ( You et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ) . Direct AR-to-diffusion conversion adapts pretrained VLMs for efficient blockwise generation ( Wu et al., 2026a ) . Beyond general understanding, specialized applications include GUI grounding with geometry-aware masking ( Kumbhar et al., 2026 ) and structured document OCR with blockwise denoising ( Dong et al., 2026 ) . These studies demonstrate the promise of diffusion in both general multimodal understanding and specialized visual tasks. Nevertheless, a unified diffusion grounding foundation that preserves precise localization across heterogeneous tasks remains underexplored. GroundAnything addresses this gap through grounding-focused training and a shared structured output interface, combining broad perceptual capabilities with efficient parallel decoding.
paragraphs.zh: 掩码扩散模型通过双向条件约束和迭代令牌恢复，为并行生成提供了一条互补路径。 扩散 VLM 展示了其在视觉指令遵循和多模态理解方面的潜力（You et al., 2026b；Li et al., 2026b）。 直接的 AR 到扩散转换可将预训练 VLM 适配用于高效的块式生成（Wu et al., 2026a）。 除了通用理解之外，其专业应用还包括基于几何感知掩码的 GUI 定位（Kumbhar et al., 2026），以及采用块式降噪的结构化文档 OCR（Dong et al., 2026）。 这些研究证明了扩散模型在通用多模态理解和专业视觉任务中的巨大潜力。 然而，一种能够在异构任务中保持精确定位能力的统一扩散定位基础，目前仍缺乏深入研究。 GroundAnything 通过专注于定位的训练和共享的结构化输出接口解决了这一空白，将广泛的感知能力与高效的并行解码相结合。

sents.zh: GroundAnything 通过专注于定位的训练和共享的结构化输出接口解决了这一空白，将广泛的感知能力与高效的并行解码相结合。

paragraphs.en: Prior work explores blockwise generation ( Arriola et al., 2025 ) , adaptive parallel sampling ( Wu et al., 2026b ; Ben-Hamu et al., 2026 ) , and diffusion-based speculative decoding ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026a ) . Further work emphasizes practical acceleration through optimized inference infrastructure ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Motivated by these advances, we examine decoding choices for GroundAnything in detail, studying their speed–accuracy trade-offs and extending the analysis to comparisons with MTP-based generation and progressive infrastructure optimizations.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的工作探讨了分块生成（Arriola 等人，2025）、自适应并行采样（Wu 等人，2026b；Ben-Hamu 等人，2026）以及基于扩散的推测性解码（Liu 等人，2026；Wu 等人，2026a）。 后续工作则强调通过优化推理基础设施来实现实际加速（Liu 等人，2025）。 受这些进展的启发，我们详细研究了 GroundAnything 的解码选项，分析了其速度与准确性的权衡关系，并将分析扩展至与基于 MTP 的生成方法以及渐进式基础设施优化的比较。

paragraphs.en: GroundAnything is a diffusion grounding model obtained by directly converting GroundAnything-VLM, an autoregressive grounding model trained through multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement post-training. It combines a MoonViT-V2 (Kimi K3) visual encoder ( Team et al., 2026 ) , a projector with 2 × 2 2\times 2 spatial aggregation and a two-layer MLP, and a Qwen3-4B language decoder ( Yang et al., 2025 ) ( Figure 1 ). Its variable-length output interface uses a shared vocabulary for semantic labels, protocol markers, and 1,000 quantized coordinate tokens ( <0> – <999> ); absent queried categories receive a None payload. The conversion introduces a mask token and jointly trains causal prediction and blockwise denoising with B = 32 B=32 ; both modes share the decoder and vocabulary head, enabling parallel grounding and optional self-speculative decoding ( Section 3.4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: GroundAnything 是一种扩散定位模型，它通过将 GroundAnything-VLM——一个通过多模态与空间预训练、监督微调以及强化后训练训练而成的自回归定位模型——直接转换而获得。 该模型结合了 MoonViT-V2（Kimi K3）视觉编码器（Team 等，2026）、一个具有 2 × 2 2\times 2 空间聚合功能的投影器和一个双层 MLP，以及 Qwen3-4B 语言解码器（Yang 等，2025）（图 1）。 其变长输出接口使用共享词汇表来表示语义标签、协议标记和 1,000 个量化坐标词元（<0> – <999>）；未查询到的类别则接收一个 None 负载。 该转换引入了一个掩码词元，并联合训练了因果预测与分块去噪（B = 32 B=32）；两种模式共享解码器和词汇表头，从而支持并行定位和可选的自我推测性解码（第 3.4.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Training data combines public datasets with annotations produced by our data engine.
paragraphs.zh: 训练数据结合了公开数据集与我们数据引擎生成的标注。

paragraphs.en: Our data engine ( Figure 2 ) fuses multi-teacher annotations at the field level and applies task-specific validation. Accepted labels train a unified grounding expert for iterative annotation; complementary teachers and local observations resolve uncertain cases. This process expands supervision while refining existing labels. Field validity and query-level coverage are checked separately, so an empty result alone does not establish absence. Fusion, validation, and expert iteration are detailed in Section 6.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的数据引擎（图 2）在字段层面对多教师标注进行融合，并应用任务特定的验证。 被接受的标签用于训练一个统一的接地专家以实现迭代标注；互补的教师和局部观察可解决不确定的情况。 这一过程在扩展监督的同时，也对现有标签进行优化。 字段有效性和查询级覆盖范围会分别检查，因此仅凭一个空结果并不能确定其不存在。 融合、验证和专家迭代的具体细节见第 6.3 节。

paragraphs.en: Base pretraining has three stages. Vision–language connector alignment trains the projector on image–text pairs with both backbones frozen. Joint multimodal pretraining updates all modules using text and multimodal supervision. General visual and video understanding develops instruction following and image/video understanding. This autoregressive foundation supports subsequent spatial specialization through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement post-training. GroundAnything additionally undergoes the conversion below; training settings are provided in Sections 6.5 and 6.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 基础预训练包含三个阶段。 视觉-语言连接器对齐阶段，在图像-文本对上训练投影器，同时冻结两个主干网络。 联合多模态预训练利用文本和多模态监督信号更新所有模块。 通用视觉与视频理解能力会发展出指令遵循以及图像/视频理解能力。 这种自回归基础通过监督微调（SFT）和强化后训练，为后续的空间专业化提供支持。 GroundAnything 还会经历下述转换；训练设置见第 6.5 节和第 6.4 节。

sents.en: Base pretraining has three stages.

paragraphs.en: After image/query prefill, GroundAnything denoises response blocks with bidirectional attention and caches the completed prefix. Sub-blocks are processed from left to right. Our default Entropy-Guided Decoding ( Liu et al., 2025 ) commits masked positions with H j ≤ τ H_{j}\leq\tau , where H j = − ∑ v p j ( v ) log p j ( v ) H_{j}=-\sum_{v}p_{j}(v)\log p_{j}(v) is the entropy of the unmodified token distribution. If none qualifies, the lowest-entropy position is committed to ensure progress. Committed tokens remain fixed, and a causal pass constructs the completed block’s cache without AR verification. Dynamic and Static Decoding instead use confidence thresholds and fixed quotas; commitment and cache construction are detailed in Section 7.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 在图像/查询预填充之后，GroundAnything 使用双向注意力对响应块进行去噪，并缓存已完成的词元前缀。 子块从左到右依次处理。 我们默认的熵引导解码（Liu 等人，2025）会锁定满足 H j ≤ τ 的掩码位置，其中 H j = − ∑ v p j ( v ) log p j ( v ) 是未修改的词元分布的熵。 如果没有符合条件的情况，则锁定熵最低的位置以确保解码继续推进。 已锁定的词元保持固定，因果推理阶段会构建已完成块的缓存，且无需进行 AR 验证。 动态与静态解码则使用置信度阈值和固定配额；锁定机制与缓存构建的细节见第 7.1 节。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate GroundAnything-VLM and GroundAnything against 44 baselines on 30 benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, covering specialized detectors, general-purpose VLMs, grounding specialists, and embodied foundations. All numerical results and conclusions involving our models are based on the mean of ten runs, using five random seeds with two runs per seed. Owing to the high computational cost, other baselines that we evaluate locally for the main leaderboard are averaged over three runs, using three random seeds with one run per seed. GPT-6 Astra uses thinking effort High . We report F1mIoU for box grounding and OCR, F1@Point for object pointing, and task-specific accuracy for spatial and GUI grounding.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在涵盖 11 种感知能力的 30 个基准测试上，将 GroundAnything-VLM 和 GroundAnything 与 44 个基线模型进行了对比评估，这些基准测试包括专用检测器、通用视觉语言模型、定位专家以及具身基础模型。 所有涉及我们模型数值结果和结论均基于十次运行的平均值，每次运行使用五个随机种子，每个种子运行两次。 由于计算成本较高，我们在本地评估主排行榜的其他基线模型时，采用三次运行的平均值，每次运行使用三个随机种子，每个种子运行一次。 GPT-6 Astra 需要较高的思考努力度。 我们报告了框定位和 OCR 的 F1mIoU、物体指向的 F1@Point，以及空间定位和 GUI 定位的任务特定准确率。

paragraphs.en: For a fair comparison of diffusion language model (DLM) decoding, all GroundAnything results in the main benchmark tables (Tables 1 – 4 ) use entropy-guided diffusion decoding, without self-speculative decoding. The self-speculative setting provides higher throughput and quality at the reported operating point, but combines diffusion drafting with causal autoregressive (AR) verification and correction; it is therefore not pure DLM decoding. We analyze this setting separately in Section 4.3 and highlight it in the teaser (Figure ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了对扩散语言模型（DLM）的解码进行公平比较，主基准表（表 1 – 4）中所有 GroundAnything 的结果均使用熵引导的扩散解码，且未采用自我推测性解码。 自我推测性设置在所报告的运行点上提供了更高的吞吐量和质量，但它将扩散草稿生成与因果自回归（AR）验证和纠正相结合；因此，它并非纯粹的 DLM 解码。 我们在第 4.3 节中单独分析了这种设置，并在预告图（图 ）中对其进行了突出显示。

paragraphs.en: Detection covers common and long-tailed objects on COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) and LVIS ( Gupta et al., 2019 ) , and dense and tiny objects on Dense200 ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) and VisDrone ( Zhu et al., 2018 ) . Referring grounding uses RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg ( Yu et al., 2016 ; Mao et al., 2016 ; Nagaraja et al., 2016 ) ; object pointing covers the four detection datasets and RefCOCOg. Spatial and GUI grounding use RoboSpatial ( Song et al., 2025 ) , RefSpatial ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , ScreenSpot-V2 ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , ScreenSpot-Pro ( Li et al., 2025 ) , and OSWorld-G ( Xie et al., 2026 ) . OCR uses HierText ( Long et al., 2022 ) , ICDAR2015 ( Karatzas et al., 2015 ) , TotalText ( Ch’Ng & Chan, 2017 ) , and SROIE ( Huang et al., 2019 ) ; layout grounding uses DocLayNet ( Pfitzmann et al., 2022 ) and M6Doc ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) . Exemplar-based visual prompting on FSC147 ( Ranjan et al., 2021 ) and Dense200 is also included in the main results.

paragraphs.en: GroundAnything-VLM establishes a new overall best among similarly sized models at 72.42%, remaining competitive with GPT-6 Astra (71.35%). GroundAnything reaches 61.75% with pure diffusion decoding, surpassing the prior overall AR state of the art at comparable scale. Figure 6 summarizes this breadth; the comparisons below examine localization precision and task-dependent diffusion–AR gaps.
paragraphs.zh: GroundAnything-VLM 在同类规模模型中取得了 72.42% 的新总体最佳成绩，并与 GPT-6 Astra（71.35%）保持竞争力。 GroundAnything 通过纯扩散解码达到了 61.75%，在相似规模下超越了此前 AR 领域的总体最优水平。 图 6 总结了这一广泛表现；以下比较将考察定位精度以及任务相关的扩散与 AR 之间的差距。

sents.en: GroundAnything-VLM establishes a new overall best among similarly sized models at 72.42%, remaining competitive with GPT-6 Astra (71.35%).
sents.zh: GroundAnything-VLM 在同类规模模型中取得了 72.42% 的新总体最佳成绩，并与 GPT-6 Astra（71.35%）保持竞争力。

sents.en: GroundAnything reaches 61.75% with pure diffusion decoding, surpassing the prior overall AR state of the art at comparable scale.
sents.zh: GroundAnything 通过纯扩散解码达到了 61.75%，在相似规模下超越了此前 AR 领域的总体最优水平。

sents.en: Figure 6 summarizes this breadth; the comparisons below examine localization precision and task-dependent diffusion–AR gaps.
sents.zh: 图 6 总结了这一广泛表现；以下比较将考察定位精度以及任务相关的扩散与 AR 之间的差距。

paragraphs.en: Scores are percentages; bold marks column bests, including ties (lower is better only for parse error). Model-name stars denote externally reported rows; entry-level stars denote source or task-interface exceptions. -- , N/A , and UNK indicate unreported values, unsupported or unresolved evaluations, and unspecified zero-shot status, respectively. Daggers flag uncertain prompt/protocol alignment, so affected scores are descriptive. Under our protocols, GroundingDINO lacks GUI/OCR/layout interfaces, and Kimi-K3 lacks compatible pointing/OCR/layout outputs; SenseNova-Vision’s GUI evaluation remains unresolved. LocateAnything lacks a supported visual-prompt interface. Starred SenseNova-Vision HierText/ICDAR2015 scores follow Han et al. (2026) ; its other OCR scores are local. Complete sources and exceptions appear in Section 10 .
paragraphs.zh: 分数为百分比；粗体标记列中的最佳值，包括平局（仅对于解析错误而言，数值越低越好）。模型名称旁的星号表示外部报告的行；入门级星号表示来源或任务接口的例外情况。--、N/A 和 UNK 分别表示未报告的值、不支持或未解决的评估，以及未指定的零样本状态。匕首符号标记提示/协议对齐存在不确定性，因此受影响的分数仅为描述性信息。根据我们的协议，GroundingDINO 缺少 GUI/OCR/布局接口，而 Kimi-K3 缺少兼容的指向/OCR/布局输出；SenseNova-Vision 的 GUI 评估尚未解决。LocateAnything 缺少受支持的视觉提示接口。带星号的 SenseNova-Vision HierText/ICDAR2015 分数遵循 Han et al. (2026)；其其他 OCR 分数为本地数据。完整的来源和例外情况见第 10 节。

paragraphs.en: GroundAnything reaches 70.04 F1mIoU on Dense200 and 91.61/91.10 on RefCOCOg val/test ( Table 1 ), extending precise diffusion grounding to crowded scenes and language-conditioned targets, although tiny-object localization remains challenging. RefCOCO avg is the unweighted mean of RefCOCO, RefCOCOg, and RefCOCO+.
paragraphs.zh: GroundAnything 在 Dense200 上达到了 70.04 F1mIoU，在 RefCOCOg 验证集和测试集上分别达到了 91.61/91.10（表 1），将精确扩散定位方法扩展到了拥挤场景和语言条件目标，尽管微小物体的定位仍然具有挑战性。 RefCOCO avg 是 RefCOCO、RefCOCOg 和 RefCOCO+ 的无加权平均值。

sents.zh: GroundAnything 在 Dense200 上达到了 70.04 F1mIoU，在 RefCOCOg 验证集和测试集上分别达到了 91.61/91.10（表 1），将精确扩散定位方法扩展到了拥挤场景和语言条件目标，尽管微小物体的定位仍然具有挑战性。

paragraphs.en: GroundAnything matches its AR counterpart on RefSpatial Unseen (62.34%) and improves ScreenSpot-Pro from 65.34% to 75.96% ( Table 2 ), while Astra remains stronger on RefSpatial and GUI tasks. RefSpatial avg averages the Location and Placement splits.
paragraphs.zh: GroundAnything 在 RefSpatial Unseen 数据集上的表现与其 AR 对应版本一致（62.34%），并将 ScreenSpot-Pro 的准确率从 65.34% 提升至 75.96%（表 2），而 Astra 在 RefSpatial 和 GUI 任务上仍更优。 RefSpatial 的平均值是对 Location 和 Placement 子集的平均值。

sents.en: GroundAnything matches its AR counterpart on RefSpatial Unseen (62.34%) and improves ScreenSpot-Pro from 65.34% to 75.96% ( Table 2 ), while Astra remains stronger on RefSpatial and GUI tasks.
sents.zh: GroundAnything 在 RefSpatial Unseen 数据集上的表现与其 AR 对应版本一致（62.34%），并将 ScreenSpot-Pro 的准确率从 65.34% 提升至 75.96%（表 2），而 Astra 在 RefSpatial 和 GUI 任务上仍更优。

paragraphs.en: The shared interface extends to text, document regions, and exemplar-matched instances: GroundAnything-VLM reaches 85.78 on DocLayNet and 74.76 on M6Doc, while GroundAnything scores 63.52 on Dense200 visual prompting ( Table 3 ). OCR and layout exhibit larger diffusion–AR gaps than referring and GUI grounding, identifying where parallel generation still sacrifices precision.
paragraphs.zh: 共享接口扩展到了文本、文档区域和示例匹配实例：GroundAnything-VLM 在 DocLayNet 上的得分为 85.78，在 M6Doc 上的得分为 74.76，而 GroundAnything 在 Dense200 视觉提示任务中的得分为 63.52（表 3）。 OCR 和布局任务的扩散–AR 差距比指代和 GUI 定位任务更大，这表明并行生成在某些情况下仍然会牺牲精度。

paragraphs.en: Following Jiang et al. (2026) , SAM-derived masks ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) determine point correctness, with F1@Point balancing misses and false positives. GroundAnything-VLM leads five of the six selected comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 Jiang 等人（2026）的研究，基于 SAM 的掩码（Kirillov 等人，2023）用于判断点的正确性，其中 F1@Point 在漏检和误报之间取得平衡。GroundAnything-VLM 在所选的六项比较中领先五项。

paragraphs.en: We report tokens per forward (TPF), output tokens per second (TPS), and COCO F1mIoU. Decoding protocols and additional analysis appear in Section 9.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了每次前向传播的令牌数（TPF）、每秒输出令牌数（TPS）以及 COCO F1mIoU。 解码协议和额外分析见第 9.1 节。

sents.en: We report tokens per forward (TPF), output tokens per second (TPS), and COCO F1mIoU.

paragraphs.en: At B = 32 B=32 , quadratic self-speculation reaches higher TPF than the linear schedule (3.17 versus 2.18), yet substantially lower throughput (49.9 versus 223.8 TPS; Figure 7 ). Its O ⁡ ( B 2 ) O(B^{2}) query-token cost offsets the reduction in forward calls, favoring the linear schedule at this operating point.
paragraphs.zh: 在 B = 32 时，二次自我推测的 TPF 高于线性调度（3.17 对比 2.18），但吞吐量却显著更低（49.9 对比 223.8 TPS；图 7）。 其 O(B²) 的查询标记成本抵消了前向调用的减少，因此在此工作点上更倾向于线性调度。

paragraphs.en: Relaxing the entropy threshold increases parallel commitment, but COCO quality falls sharply beyond τ = 0.8 \tau=0.8 ( Figure 8 ). At B = 32 B=32 , τ = 0.8 \tau=0.8 achieves the highest F1mIoU in this threshold sweep (60.72) at 127.0 TPS, or 2.56 × 2.56\times GroundAnything-VLM throughput. Block size also changes this balance: entropy-guided quality peaks at B = 16 B=16 in this COCO sweep, whereas linear self-speculation peaks at B = 32 B=32 ( Figure 9 ); larger blocks are therefore not uniformly better.
paragraphs.zh: 放宽熵阈值会增加并行提交，但当 τ = 0.8 \tau=0.8 时，COCO 质量会急剧下降（图 8）。 在 B = 32 B=32 时，τ = 0.8 \tau=0.8 在此阈值扫描中实现了最高的 F1mIoU（60.72），吞吐量为 127.0 TPS，即 GroundAnything-VLM 吞吐量的 2.56 × 2.56\times。 块大小也会改变这种平衡：在此 COCO 扫描中，由熵引导的质量在 B = 16 B=16 时达到峰值，而线性自我推测则在 B = 32 B=32 时达到峰值（图 9）；因此，更大的块并非总是更好。

paragraphs.en: We match visual inputs, adaptation data, tokenization, and prefixes, and freeze the same converted model’s causal branch as verifier. The primary MTP baseline is an in-house causal drafter; bidirectional block-MTP and retrained causal-DLM controls test the role of attention ( Section 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们对视觉输入、适应数据、分词和前缀进行匹配，并将同一转换模型的因果分支冻结作为验证器。 主要的 MTP 基线是一个内部开发的因果起草器；双向块-MTP 和重新训练的因果-DLM 控制实验用于测试注意力机制的作用（第 8 节）。

sents.en: We match visual inputs, adaptation data, tokenization, and prefixes, and freeze the same converted model’s causal branch as verifier.
sents.zh: 我们对视觉输入、适应数据、分词和前缀进行匹配，并将同一转换模型的因果分支冻结作为验证器。

sents.en: The primary MTP baseline is an in-house causal drafter; bidirectional block-MTP and retrained causal-DLM controls test the role of attention ( Section 8 ).
sents.zh: 主要的 MTP 基线是一个内部开发的因果起草器；双向块-MTP 和重新训练的因果-DLM 控制实验用于测试注意力机制的作用（第 8 节）。

paragraphs.en: At K = 16 K=16 , one-step DLM accepts 3.48 draft tokens per round versus 2.69 for causal MTP ( Figure 11 ), yielding more useful proposals at the same candidate length.
paragraphs.zh: 在 K = 16 时，单步 DLM 每轮可接受 3.48 个草稿标记，而因果 MTP 仅为 2.69（图 11），因此在相同候选长度下能生成更多有用的提案。

paragraphs.en: Including drafting, verification, and rejected work, one-step DLM reduces full-round cost per accepted draft token from 7.71 to 5.38 ms ( Figure 11 ). Higher acceptance therefore translates into lower wall-clock cost at this operating point.
paragraphs.zh: 包括起草、验证和废弃的工作在内，一步式 DLM 将每个被接受的草稿标记的全轮成本从 7.71 ms 降低到 5.38 ms（图 11）。 因此，更高的接受率意味着在此工作点下，实际运行成本更低。

sents.en: Including drafting, verification, and rejected work, one-step DLM reduces full-round cost per accepted draft token from 7.71 to 5.38 ms ( Figure 11 ).
sents.zh: 包括起草、验证和废弃的工作在内，一步式 DLM 将每个被接受的草稿标记的全轮成本从 7.71 ms 降低到 5.38 ms（图 11）。

sents.en: Higher acceptance therefore translates into lower wall-clock cost at this operating point.
sents.zh: 因此，更高的接受率意味着在此工作点下，实际运行成本更低。

paragraphs.en: At K = 16 K=16 , a second DLM refinement step lowers this cost to 4.70 ms; further refinement increases it. With validation-selected policies on the long-output subset, DLM commits 97.1 versus 84.6 tokens within 400 ms, although MTP leads at 50 ms ( Figure 12 ). Refinement is thus useful when its acceptance gain repays its additional latency.
paragraphs.zh: 在 K = 16 时，第二次 DLM 优化步骤将这一成本降至 4.70 毫秒；进一步优化则会使其增加。 在长输出子集上使用验证阶段选定的策略时，DLM 在 400 毫秒内会分配 97.1 个标记，而 MTP 则为 84.6 个标记（尽管在 50 毫秒时 MTP 领先，见图 12）。 因此，当优化带来的收益能够弥补其额外延迟时，这种优化就是有意义的。

sents.en: At K = 16 K=16 , a second DLM refinement step lowers this cost to 4.70 ms; further refinement increases it.
sents.zh: 在 K = 16 时，第二次 DLM 优化步骤将这一成本降至 4.70 毫秒；进一步优化则会使其增加。

sents.en: With validation-selected policies on the long-output subset, DLM commits 97.1 versus 84.6 tokens within 400 ms, although MTP leads at 50 ms ( Figure 12 ).
sents.zh: 在长输出子集上使用验证阶段选定的策略时，DLM 在 400 毫秒内会分配 97.1 个标记，而 MTP 则为 84.6 个标记（尽管在 50 毫秒时 MTP 领先，见图 12）。

sents.en: Refinement is thus useful when its acceptance gain repays its additional latency.
sents.zh: 因此，当优化带来的收益能够弥补其额外延迟时，这种优化就是有意义的。

paragraphs.en: Bidirectional DLM reduces Dense200’s unmatched valid-proposal rate from 24.89% for causal MTP to 14.79%; its retrained causal counterpart scores 21.74% ( Figure 13 ). This supports bidirectional attention for drafting jointly constrained spatial predictions. Bidirectional block-MTP also improves draft quality, so the benefit is not exclusive to diffusion.
paragraphs.zh: 双向 DLM 将 Dense200 在因果 MTP 下的未匹配有效提案率从 24.89% 降低至 14.79%；其重新训练的因果版本得分为 21.74%（图 13）。 这支持了用于联合约束空间预测草案的双向注意力机制。 双向块-MTP 也能提升草案质量，因此这种优势并非扩散模型独有。

sents.en: Bidirectional DLM reduces Dense200’s unmatched valid-proposal rate from 24.89% for causal MTP to 14.79%; its retrained causal counterpart scores 21.74% ( Figure 13 ).
sents.zh: 双向 DLM 将 Dense200 在因果 MTP 下的未匹配有效提案率从 24.89% 降低至 14.79%；其重新训练的因果版本得分为 21.74%（图 13）。

sents.en: This supports bidirectional attention for drafting jointly constrained spatial predictions.
sents.zh: 这支持了用于联合约束空间预测草案的双向注意力机制。

sents.en: Bidirectional block-MTP also improves draft quality, so the benefit is not exclusive to diffusion.
sents.zh: 双向块-MTP 也能提升草案质量，因此这种优势并非扩散模型独有。

paragraphs.en: These gains concern draft efficiency and reliability; exact shared verification preserves the AR verifier’s completed output.
paragraphs.zh: 这些改进涉及草案的效率与可靠性；精确的共享验证可保留 AR 验证器已完成的结果。

paragraphs.en: Progressive integration with SGLang, CUDA Graph, and FP8 reduces time per output token across all four decoding modes ( Figure 14 ). The complete stack yields 3.45 3.45 – 4.06 × 4.06\times speedups over each mode’s native PyTorch implementation, with self-speculation reaching 3.73 ms/token. Implementation gains are measured within each decoding mode, separately from algorithmic speedups ( Section 9.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 与 SGLang、CUDA Graph 和 FP8 的渐进式集成，在所有四种解码模式下都减少了每个输出标记所需的时间（图 14）。 完整的堆栈相比每种模式的原生 PyTorch 实现，实现了 3.45–4.06× 的速度提升，其中自推测模式达到了 3.73 ms/标记。 实现方面的增益是在每种解码模式内部测量的，与算法层面的速度提升分开计算（第 9.2 节）。

sents.en: Progressive integration with SGLang, CUDA Graph, and FP8 reduces time per output token across all four decoding modes ( Figure 14 ).
sents.zh: 与 SGLang、CUDA Graph 和 FP8 的渐进式集成，在所有四种解码模式下都减少了每个输出标记所需的时间（图 14）。

sents.en: The complete stack yields 3.45 3.45 – 4.06 × 4.06\times speedups over each mode’s native PyTorch implementation, with self-speculation reaching 3.73 ms/token.
sents.zh: 完整的堆栈相比每种模式的原生 PyTorch 实现，实现了 3.45–4.06× 的速度提升，其中自推测模式达到了 3.73 ms/标记。

paragraphs.en: Quantized coordinates improve the reported ablation average by 1.43 pp for GroundAnything-VLM and 5.68 pp for GroundAnything over textual coordinates ( Figure 15 ).
paragraphs.zh: 与文本坐标相比，量化坐标使 GroundAnything-VLM 的消融平均报告值提升了 1.43 pp，GroundAnything 的报告值则提升了 5.68 pp（图 15）。

paragraphs.en: MoonViT-V2 gives the strongest AR and DLM scores among the tested encoders. Section 9.3.1 analyzes when multi-level visual evidence can help coordinate prediction; the encoder ablation supports our choice under this recipe.
paragraphs.zh: 在测试的编码器中，MoonViT-V2 获得了最高的 AR 和 DLM 分数。 第 9.3.1 节分析了多层视觉证据何时有助于协调预测；在此方案下，编码器的消融分析支持了我们的选择。

paragraphs.zh: 移除第三阶段会导致 DLM 出现最大幅度的下降（16.62 pp）。

paragraphs.en: The shared output format uses 7.6 tokens/box on COCO and 5.1 on Dense200, compared with 148.8 and 74.5 for the SEED1.5-VL reference reported by Jiang et al. (2026) ( Table 5 ). Figure 16 shows how generation time and output length vary with predicted object count: GroundAnything reduces generation time across the displayed ranges, with larger absolute savings for longer outputs ( Section 9.4 ).

paragraphs.en: We introduced GroundAnything, reconciling fast parallel decoding with broad and precise visual grounding. Structured grounding naturally suits DLMs: its predictions are jointly constrained by shared visual evidence. Diffusion complements the Transformer backbone through a generation process with distinctive strengths in parallel filling and structured outputs. Causal conditioning supports long outputs across blocks, while diffusion accelerates prediction within them. GroundAnything thus highlights a broader principle: generation should follow task structure, and spatial evidence need not be inferred in the order it is serialized.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 GroundAnything，实现了快速并行解码与广泛且精确的视觉定位之间的平衡。 结构化定位天然适合 DLM：其预测受到共享视觉证据的联合约束。 扩散模型通过生成过程补充了 Transformer 主干网络，该过程在并行填充和结构化输出方面具有独特的优势。 因果条件支持跨块的长输出，而扩散模型则加速了块内的预测过程。 因此，GroundAnything 凸显了一个更广泛的原则：生成应遵循任务结构，空间证据无需按照其序列化的顺序进行推断。

paragraphs.en: This work does not involve human-subject studies. All datasets and evaluation benchmarks used in this work were obtained from publicly available or appropriately licensed sources in accordance with their respective terms and licenses. The experiments focus on visual grounding and structured visual understanding and do not involve real-world robotic control, autonomous driving, or interaction with people. GroundAnything is developed as a general-purpose visual grounding model for research rather than for safety-critical real-world deployment. Any future integration into embodied or autonomous systems should be subject to appropriate safety evaluation and human oversight. The authors declare no conflicts of interest.

paragraphs.en: We will publicly release the code, model weights of GroundAnything and GroundAnything-VLM, and evaluation data to support systematic and reproducible evaluation. The release will include training and decoding configurations, inference implementations, and evaluation scripts with standardized task prompts, output parsers, and metric implementations. The shared architecture, tokenizer, visual processing, and input/output protocol are specified in Sections 6.2 and 6.1 ; the data engine and validation pipeline in Section 6.3 ; and base VLM training, AR-to-diffusion conversion, and continued supervised fine-tuning in Sections 6.5 , 6.7 and 6.4 . Variant-specific GRPO configurations and task rewards are detailed in Sections 6.8 , 6.9 and 6.10 . Direct diffusion decoding, optional self-speculative decoding, and execution optimizations are described in Sections 7.1 , 7.2 and 7.3 . Controlled DLM–MTP comparisons are documented in Section 8 , while speed metrics, decoding sensitivity, and infrastructure comparisons appear in Sections 9.1 and 9.2 . Architecture and training ablations and output-token efficiency analyses are provided in Sections 9.3 and 9.4 . The benchmark suite, evaluation metrics, reporting conventions, and complete task-level results are given in Section 10 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将公开发布 GroundAnything 和 GroundAnything-VLM 的代码、模型权重以及评估数据，以支持系统化且可重复的评估。 此次发布将包括训练与解码配置、推理实现，以及包含标准化任务提示、输出解析器和指标实现的评估脚本。 共享的架构、分词器、视觉处理及输入/输出协议详见第 6.2 节和第 6.1 节；数据引擎与验证流程详见第 6.3 节；基础 VLM 训练、AR-to-diffusion 转换以及持续监督微调则分别详见第 6.5 节、第 6.7 节和第 6.4 节。 各变体特定的 GRPO 配置与任务奖励详见第 6.8 节、第 6.9 节和第 6.10 节。 直接扩散解码、可选的自我推测性解码及执行优化详见第 7.1 节、第 7.2 节和第 7.3 节。 受控的 DLM–MTP 对比结果记录于第 8 节，而速度指标、解码敏感性及基础设施对比则见于第 9.1 节和第 9.2 节。 架构与训练消融分析以及输出词元效率分析详见第 9.3 节和第 9.4 节。 基准测试套件、评估指标、报告规范及完整的任务级结果均列于第 10 节。

paragraphs.en: GroundAnything and GroundAnything-VLM share a structured interface: the query specifies what evidence to extract, and each response entry associates a semantic identifier with spatial coordinates. The geometry is task-dependent, while the enclosing grammar remains unchanged, following the unified grounding formulation of Jiang et al. (2026) .
paragraphs.zh: GroundAnything 和 GroundAnything-VLM 共享一个结构化接口：查询指定了需要提取的证据，而每个响应条目都将一个语义标识符与空间坐标关联起来。 几何结构因任务而异，但所遵循的封装语法保持不变，该语法基于 Jiang 等人（2026）提出的统一接地公式。

sents.en: The geometry is task-dependent, while the enclosing grammar remains unchanged, following the unified grounding formulation of Jiang et al. (2026) .
sents.zh: 几何结构因任务而异，但所遵循的封装语法保持不变，该语法基于 Jiang 等人（2026）提出的统一接地公式。

paragraphs.en: Boxes use four atomic coordinate tokens in ( x 1 , y 1 , x 2 , y 2 ) (x_{1},y_{1},x_{2},y_{2}) order; points use two in ( x , y ) (x,y) order. Instances sharing an identifier occupy one wrapper, with tuples separated by commas without spaces. Distinct entries are separated by a comma and a space. Ordered point sequences retain their temporal order. The ordinary text None denotes an absent queried target, not a padding element. OCR transcriptions occupy the identifier field rather than a separate text channel.
paragraphs.zh: 方框使用四个原子坐标标记，顺序为 ( x 1 , y 1 , x 2 , y 2 ) (x_{1},y_{1},x_{2},y_{2})；点则使用两个，顺序为 ( x , y ) (x,y)。 共享同一标识符的实例占用一个包装器，其中的元组以逗号分隔且无空格。 不同的条目以逗号加空格分隔。 有序点序列保持其时间顺序不变。 普通文本 None 表示所查询的目标不存在，而非填充元素。 OCR 转录内容占用标识符字段，而非独立的文本通道。

paragraphs.en: The variants share a MoonViT-V2 (Kimi K3) visual encoder, a multimodal projector, and a Qwen3-4B language architecture. All language layers use full attention and one-dimensional rotary position indices. Dynamic image processing supplies at most 1024 projected visual tokens, corresponding to 4096 patches before 2 × 2 2\times 2 aggregation; channel means and standard deviations are both ( 0.5 , 0.5 , 0.5 ) (0.5,0.5,0.5) . Table 8 gives the module specifications.

paragraphs.en: Complementary teachers provide semantic, localization, segmentation, text, interface, and layout evidence. Category discovery precedes category-conditioned localization; category names are normalized while attributes needed for referring expressions are retained. Predictions are mapped back to the original image and aligned only when their query scope and annotation granularity agree. Fusion operates on individual fields, allowing reliable text or geometry to be retained without accepting an entire inconsistent annotation.
paragraphs.zh: 辅助教师提供语义、定位、分割、文本、界面和布局方面的证据。 类别发现先于条件化的类别定位；类别名称会被规范化，同时保留指代表达所需的属性。 预测结果会映射回原始图像，并且仅当它们的查询范围与标注粒度一致时才会进行对齐。 融合操作针对各个字段单独执行，从而可以在不采纳整个不一致标注的前提下，保留可靠的文本或几何信息。

paragraphs.en: Task-specific checks assess geometric validity, semantic consistency, text–region agreement, and cross-view support. Each dependency has a validation state a ⁡ ( f ) ∈ { pass , fail , pending } a(f)\in\{\mathrm{pass},\mathrm{fail},\mathrm{pending}\} ; query-level coverage c ⁡ ( I , Q ) c(I,Q) uses the same state space. Coverage checks whether the required query scope has been examined and relevant unresolved proposals and matching conflicts have been addressed. Unresolved dependencies trigger complementary teachers or targeted local observations.
paragraphs.zh: 任务特定检查用于评估几何有效性、语义一致性、文本与区域的匹配性，以及跨视图支持。 每个依赖项都有一个验证状态 a⁡(f)∈{pass,fail,pending}；查询级覆盖 c⁡(I,Q) 使用相同的状态空间。 覆盖检查用于确认所需的查询范围是否已被检验，且相关的未解决提案和匹配冲突是否已得到处理。 未解决的依赖项会触发互补教师或针对性的局部观察。

paragraphs.en: so every required dependency must pass, and exhaustive queries additionally require validated coverage. For example, validating the returned boxes does not establish that every queried instance has been found; an all-instance query remains unaccepted while coverage is pending.

paragraphs.en: An answer with no instances still requires verification of its query–answer relation. Its dependency set explicitly includes a query-scoped absence fact f abs ∈ ℱ ⁡ ( I , Q , Y ) f_{\mathrm{abs}}\in\mathcal{F}(I,Q,Y) , so an empty prediction never yields an empty dependency set. An unsupported absence claim remains pending; contrary evidence makes it fail. It passes only when absence is verified and c ⁡ ( I , Q ) = pass c(I,Q)=\mathrm{pass} , even when h ⁡ ( Q ) = 0 h(Q)=0 . Missing outputs, failed annotation runs, and unresolved empty predictions do not constitute evidence of absence. These requirements prevent empty predictions from being accepted through a vacuously true check over an empty set.
paragraphs.zh: 即使答案中没有实例，仍需验证其查询与答案之间的关系。 其依赖集明确包含一个查询范围内的缺失事实 f abs ∈ ℱ ⁡ ( I , Q , Y ) f_{\mathrm{abs}}\in\mathcal{F}(I,Q,Y) ，因此空预测绝不会产生空的依赖集。 缺乏支持的缺失主张仍处于待验证状态；相反证据将使其失效。 仅当缺失性得到验证且 c ⁡ ( I , Q ) = pass c(I,Q)=\mathrm{pass} 时，该主张才会通过，即使 h ⁡ ( Q ) = 0 h(Q)=0 。 缺失的输出、失败的标注运行以及未解决的空预测，均不构成缺失的证据。 这些要求可防止通过针对空集的“空真”检查来接受空预测。

sents.en: An answer with no instances still requires verification of its query–answer relation.
sents.zh: 即使答案中没有实例，仍需验证其查询与答案之间的关系。

sents.en: Its dependency set explicitly includes a query-scoped absence fact f abs ∈ ℱ ⁡ ( I , Q , Y ) f_{\mathrm{abs}}\in\mathcal{F}(I,Q,Y) , so an empty prediction never yields an empty dependency set.
sents.zh: 其依赖集明确包含一个查询范围内的缺失事实 f abs ∈ ℱ ⁡ ( I , Q , Y ) f_{\mathrm{abs}}\in\mathcal{F}(I,Q,Y) ，因此空预测绝不会产生空的依赖集。

sents.en: An unsupported absence claim remains pending; contrary evidence makes it fail.
sents.zh: 缺乏支持的缺失主张仍处于待验证状态；相反证据将使其失效。

sents.en: It passes only when absence is verified and c ⁡ ( I , Q ) = pass c(I,Q)=\mathrm{pass} , even when h ⁡ ( Q ) = 0 h(Q)=0 .
sents.zh: 仅当缺失性得到验证且 c ⁡ ( I , Q ) = pass c(I,Q)=\mathrm{pass} 时，该主张才会通过，即使 h ⁡ ( Q ) = 0 h(Q)=0 。

sents.en: Missing outputs, failed annotation runs, and unresolved empty predictions do not constitute evidence of absence.
sents.zh: 缺失的输出、失败的标注运行以及未解决的空预测，均不构成缺失的证据。

sents.en: These requirements prevent empty predictions from being accepted through a vacuously true check over an empty set.
sents.zh: 这些要求可防止通过针对空集的“空真”检查来接受空预测。

paragraphs.en: Derived box, point, referring, and visual-prompt supervision preserves its dependencies on the validated source evidence; crops and coordinate transforms remain consistent with visible content.
paragraphs.zh: 派生框、点、指代和视觉提示的监督保留了其对已验证源证据的依赖关系；裁剪和坐标变换与可见内容保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Accepted annotations train a unified grounding expert, which then proposes annotations for further validation. Difficult cases receive targeted crops or complementary teacher evidence. New evidence can correct or retire previous labels, with versioned annotation snapshots keeping each training input fixed. This loop improves both coverage and field consistency rather than merely accumulating predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 已接受的标注用于训练一个统一的接地专家，该专家随后会提出标注以供进一步验证。 困难案例会获得针对性的裁剪或补充的教师证据。 新证据可以纠正或撤销先前的标签，而带有版本信息的标注快照则确保每次训练输入保持固定。 这种循环能够提升覆盖范围和领域一致性，而不仅仅是简单累积预测结果。

sents.en: Accepted annotations train a unified grounding expert, which then proposes annotations for further validation.
sents.zh: 已接受的标注用于训练一个统一的接地专家，该专家随后会提出标注以供进一步验证。

sents.en: Difficult cases receive targeted crops or complementary teacher evidence.
sents.zh: 困难案例会获得针对性的裁剪或补充的教师证据。

sents.en: New evidence can correct or retire previous labels, with versioned annotation snapshots keeping each training input fixed.
sents.zh: 新证据可以纠正或撤销先前的标签，而带有版本信息的标注快照则确保每次训练输入保持固定。

sents.en: This loop improves both coverage and field consistency rather than merely accumulating predictions.
sents.zh: 这种循环能够提升覆盖范围和领域一致性，而不仅仅是简单累积预测结果。

paragraphs.en: GroundAnything follows four training phases: Base VLM Training (Pretrain 1), Coordinate Alignment (Pretrain 2, also termed SFT), AR-to-Diffusion conversion, and reinforcement learning (RL). GroundAnything-VLM follows three phases: Base VLM Training, Coordinate Alignment, and RL. The Stage 1–4 numbering below refers specifically to pretraining and alignment: Stages 1–3 belong to Pretrain 1, while Stage 4 is Pretrain 2. Table 10 summarizes the two pipelines and their relation to Figure 4 .
paragraphs.zh: GroundAnything 遵循四个训练阶段：基础 VLM 训练（预训练 1）、坐标对齐（预训练 2，也称为 SFT）、AR-to-Diffusion 转换以及强化学习（RL）。 GroundAnything-VLM 遵循三个阶段：基础 VLM 训练、坐标对齐和 RL。 下面提到的阶段 1–4 的编号特指预训练和对齐：阶段 1–3 属于预训练 1，而阶段 4 是预训练 2。 表 10 总结了这两种流程及其与图 4 的关系。

sents.en: GroundAnything follows four training phases: Base VLM Training (Pretrain 1), Coordinate Alignment (Pretrain 2, also termed SFT), AR-to-Diffusion conversion, and reinforcement learning (RL).
sents.zh: GroundAnything 遵循四个训练阶段：基础 VLM 训练（预训练 1）、坐标对齐（预训练 2，也称为 SFT）、AR-to-Diffusion 转换以及强化学习（RL）。

sents.en: GroundAnything-VLM follows three phases: Base VLM Training, Coordinate Alignment, and RL.
sents.zh: GroundAnything-VLM 遵循三个阶段：基础 VLM 训练、坐标对齐和 RL。

sents.en: The Stage 1–4 numbering below refers specifically to pretraining and alignment: Stages 1–3 belong to Pretrain 1, while Stage 4 is Pretrain 2.
sents.zh: 下面提到的阶段 1–4 的编号特指预训练和对齐：阶段 1–3 属于预训练 1，而阶段 4 是预训练 2。

sents.en: Table 10 summarizes the two pipelines and their relation to Figure 4 .
sents.zh: 表 10 总结了这两种流程及其与图 4 的关系。

paragraphs.en: The vision encoder and language backbone are frozen, and only the projector is trained on image-caption data. Assistant-only causal cross-entropy aligns the visual features with the language input space.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉编码器和语言主干网络被冻结，仅对投影器在图像-描述数据上进行训练。 仅使用助手模型的因果交叉熵损失将视觉特征与语言输入空间进行对齐。

sents.en: The vision encoder and language backbone are frozen, and only the projector is trained on image-caption data.
sents.zh: 视觉编码器和语言主干网络被冻结，仅对投影器在图像-描述数据上进行训练。

sents.en: Assistant-only causal cross-entropy aligns the visual features with the language input space.
sents.zh: 仅使用助手模型的因果交叉熵损失将视觉特征与语言输入空间进行对齐。

paragraphs.en: All modules are unfrozen and jointly trained on pure text and general image–text data. Pure-text examples supervise all valid causal text targets; multimodal examples supervise assistant responses, excluding visual inputs, prompts, and masked template positions. The text and multimodal losses are normalized separately over their valid target tokens and then summed, ℒ mix = ℒ text + ℒ vlm \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mix}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{text}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{vlm}} . Counts are aggregated across data-parallel workers so that each domain contributes its global token mean. Packing preserves independent subsequence boundaries and supervision masks.
paragraphs.zh: 所有模块均未冻结，并在纯文本和通用图像-文本数据上联合训练。 纯文本示例用于监督所有有效的因果文本目标；多模态示例则用于监督助手响应，但不包括视觉输入、提示词和掩码模板位置。 文本损失和多模态损失分别在其有效目标标记上进行归一化，然后求和：ℒ mix = ℒ text + ℒ vlm \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mix}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{text}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{vlm}}。 计数在所有数据并行工作节点上汇总，以确保每个领域都能贡献其全局标记均值。 打包操作保留了独立的子序列边界和监督掩码。

sents.en: All modules are unfrozen and jointly trained on pure text and general image–text data.
sents.zh: 所有模块均未冻结，并在纯文本和通用图像-文本数据上联合训练。

sents.en: Pure-text examples supervise all valid causal text targets; multimodal examples supervise assistant responses, excluding visual inputs, prompts, and masked template positions.
sents.zh: 纯文本示例用于监督所有有效的因果文本目标；多模态示例则用于监督助手响应，但不包括视觉输入、提示词和掩码模板位置。

sents.en: The text and multimodal losses are normalized separately over their valid target tokens and then summed, ℒ mix = ℒ text + ℒ vlm \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mix}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{text}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{vlm}} .
sents.zh: 文本损失和多模态损失分别在其有效目标标记上进行归一化，然后求和：ℒ mix = ℒ text + ℒ vlm \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mix}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{text}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{vlm}}。

sents.en: Counts are aggregated across data-parallel workers so that each domain contributes its global token mean.
sents.zh: 计数在所有数据并行工作节点上汇总，以确保每个领域都能贡献其全局标记均值。

sents.en: Packing preserves independent subsequence boundaries and supervision masks.
sents.zh: 打包操作保留了独立的子序列边界和监督掩码。

paragraphs.en: All modules continue training on general visual question answering and instruction-following data, image captions, and video data with assistant-only causal cross-entropy. The configured context and packing lengths are both 32K. This stage has no separate pure-text quota or dedicated spatial-specialization mixture; spatial supervision is concentrated in Pretrain 2. Aggregate base-pretraining exposure exceeds 700B tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 所有模块继续在通用视觉问答和指令遵循数据、图像标题以及视频数据上进行训练，并使用仅助理的因果交叉熵损失。 配置好的上下文长度和打包长度均为 32K。 此阶段没有独立的纯文本配额或专门的空间特化混合数据；空间监督集中在预训练 2 中。 基础预训练的总暴露量超过 7000 亿个词元。

sents.en: All modules continue training on general visual question answering and instruction-following data, image captions, and video data with assistant-only causal cross-entropy.
sents.zh: 所有模块继续在通用视觉问答和指令遵循数据、图像标题以及视频数据上进行训练，并使用仅助理的因果交叉熵损失。

sents.en: The configured context and packing lengths are both 32K.
sents.zh: 配置好的上下文长度和打包长度均为 32K。

sents.en: This stage has no separate pure-text quota or dedicated spatial-specialization mixture; spatial supervision is concentrated in Pretrain 2.
sents.zh: 此阶段没有独立的纯文本配额或专门的空间特化混合数据；空间监督集中在预训练 2 中。

sents.en: Aggregate base-pretraining exposure exceeds 700B tokens.
sents.zh: 基础预训练的总暴露量超过 7000 亿个词元。

paragraphs.en: Initialized from the Stage 3 checkpoint, coordinate alignment updates the vision encoder, projector, and language parameters on eight spatial task groups: detection, GUI grounding, referring grounding, referring pointing, OCR, document layout, dense pointing and counting, and visual prompting. Boxes, points, semantic identifiers, and protocol markers are supervised jointly as assistant-response tokens. The coordinate tokens <0> through <999> use the same causal cross-entropy objective as the other valid response tokens. This single alignment phase is the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) phase referred to in the main text. Its context and packing lengths are 8K.
paragraphs.zh: 从第 3 阶段检查点初始化后，坐标对齐会更新视觉编码器、投影器和语言模型在八个空间任务组上的参数：检测、GUI 定位、指代定位、指代指向、OCR、文档布局、密集指向与计数以及视觉提示。 框、点、语义标识符和协议标记被联合监督为助手响应令牌。 坐标令牌 <0> 到 <999> 使用与其他有效响应令牌相同的因果交叉熵目标函数。 这个单一的对齐阶段即为主文中提到的监督微调（SFT）阶段。 其上下文和打包长度为 8K。

sents.en: Initialized from the Stage 3 checkpoint, coordinate alignment updates the vision encoder, projector, and language parameters on eight spatial task groups: detection, GUI grounding, referring grounding, referring pointing, OCR, document layout, dense pointing and counting, and visual prompting.
sents.zh: 从第 3 阶段检查点初始化后，坐标对齐会更新视觉编码器、投影器和语言模型在八个空间任务组上的参数：检测、GUI 定位、指代定位、指代指向、OCR、文档布局、密集指向与计数以及视觉提示。

sents.en: Boxes, points, semantic identifiers, and protocol markers are supervised jointly as assistant-response tokens.
sents.zh: 框、点、语义标识符和协议标记被联合监督为助手响应令牌。

sents.en: The coordinate tokens <0> through <999> use the same causal cross-entropy objective as the other valid response tokens.
sents.zh: 坐标令牌 <0> 到 <999> 使用与其他有效响应令牌相同的因果交叉熵目标函数。

sents.en: This single alignment phase is the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) phase referred to in the main text.
sents.zh: 这个单一的对齐阶段即为主文中提到的监督微调（SFT）阶段。

sents.en: Its context and packing lengths are 8K.
sents.zh: 其上下文和打包长度为 8K。

paragraphs.en: Table 11 gives the configured recipe for both pretraining phases. After coordinate alignment, GroundAnything-VLM proceeds to RL, while GroundAnything first undergoes the AR-to-Diffusion conversion in Section 6.7 .
paragraphs.zh: 表 11 给出了两个预训练阶段的配置配方。 坐标对齐后，GroundAnything-VLM 进入强化学习阶段，而 GroundAnything 则首先执行第 6.7 节中的 AR-to-Diffusion 转换。

sents.en: Table 11 gives the configured recipe for both pretraining phases.
sents.zh: 表 11 给出了两个预训练阶段的配置配方。

sents.en: After coordinate alignment, GroundAnything-VLM proceeds to RL, while GroundAnything first undergoes the AR-to-Diffusion conversion in Section 6.7 .
sents.zh: 坐标对齐后，GroundAnything-VLM 进入强化学习阶段，而 GroundAnything 则首先执行第 6.7 节中的 AR-to-Diffusion 转换。

paragraphs.en: All four pretraining/alignment stages use BF16, ZeRO-1, AdamW with ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.95) , FlashAttention, and activation checkpointing. Global batches count packed sequences and equal the number of GPUs times the per-device batch times gradient accumulation. Here 8K and 32K denote 8192 and 32768 tokens, respectively, and one epoch denotes the configured training budget. Language parameters include the untied input embedding and output head.
paragraphs.zh: 所有四个预训练/对齐阶段均使用 BF16、ZeRO-1、AdamW（其中 (β₁, β₂) = (0.9, 0.95)）、FlashAttention 和激活函数检查点机制。 全局批量数量统计了打包后的序列数，等于 GPU 数量乘以每设备批量数再乘以梯度累积次数。 此处 8K 和 32K 分别表示 8192 和 32768 个词元，而一个周期则表示预配置的训练预算。 语言模型参数包括未绑定的输入嵌入层和输出头。

sents.en: All four pretraining/alignment stages use BF16, ZeRO-1, AdamW with ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.95) , FlashAttention, and activation checkpointing.
sents.zh: 所有四个预训练/对齐阶段均使用 BF16、ZeRO-1、AdamW（其中 (β₁, β₂) = (0.9, 0.95)）、FlashAttention 和激活函数检查点机制。

sents.en: Global batches count packed sequences and equal the number of GPUs times the per-device batch times gradient accumulation.
sents.zh: 全局批量数量统计了打包后的序列数，等于 GPU 数量乘以每设备批量数再乘以梯度累积次数。

sents.en: Here 8K and 32K denote 8192 and 32768 tokens, respectively, and one epoch denotes the configured training budget.
sents.zh: 此处 8K 和 32K 分别表示 8192 和 32768 个词元，而一个周期则表示预配置的训练预算。

sents.en: Language parameters include the untied input embedding and output head.
sents.zh: 语言模型参数包括未绑定的输入嵌入层和输出头。

paragraphs.en: GroundAnything is initialized from the autoregressive checkpoint after coordinate alignment. Direct multimodal conversion ( Wu et al., 2026a ) retains its grounding vocabulary and output grammar. Let x = [ V , P , Y ] x=[V,P,Y] contain visual embeddings V V , the text prompt P P encoding query Q Q , and response Y Y . Supervised response spans are partitioned into consecutive blocks of B = 32 B=32 tokens. Blocks may cross geometric-tuple boundaries, stop at response-span boundaries, and have a shorter final block; they require no semantic padding.
paragraphs.zh: GroundAnything 在坐标对齐后从自回归检查点初始化。 直接多模态转换（Wu 等人，2026a）保留其 grounding 词汇表和输出语法。 令 x = [ V , P , Y ] x=[V,P,Y] 包含视觉嵌入 V、编码查询 Q 的文本提示 P 以及响应 Y。 监督响应的跨度被划分为连续的长度为 B = 32 个 token 的块。 这些块可能跨越几何元组边界，在响应跨度边界处停止，且最后一个块可能较短；它们不需要语义填充。

sents.en: GroundAnything is initialized from the autoregressive checkpoint after coordinate alignment.
sents.zh: GroundAnything 在坐标对齐后从自回归检查点初始化。

sents.en: Direct multimodal conversion ( Wu et al., 2026a ) retains its grounding vocabulary and output grammar.
sents.zh: 直接多模态转换（Wu 等人，2026a）保留其 grounding 词汇表和输出语法。

sents.en: Let x = [ V , P , Y ] x=[V,P,Y] contain visual embeddings V V , the text prompt P P encoding query Q Q , and response Y Y .
sents.zh: 令 x = [ V , P , Y ] x=[V,P,Y] 包含视觉嵌入 V、编码查询 Q 的文本提示 P 以及响应 Y。

sents.en: Supervised response spans are partitioned into consecutive blocks of B = 32 B=32 tokens.
sents.zh: 监督响应的跨度被划分为连续的长度为 B = 32 个 token 的块。

sents.en: Blocks may cross geometric-tuple boundaries, stop at response-span boundaries, and have a shorter final block; they require no semantic padding.
sents.zh: 这些块可能跨越几何元组边界，在响应跨度边界处停止，且最后一个块可能较短；它们不需要语义填充。

paragraphs.en: For each response block b b , sample t b ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) t_{b}\sim\mathcal{U}(0,1) . For every supervised non-EOS position i i in that block, draw m i ( 1 ) ∼ Bernoulli ⁡ ( t b ) m_{i}^{(1)}\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(t_{b}) and set m i ( 2 ) = 1 − m i ( 1 ) m_{i}^{(2)}=1-m_{i}^{(1)} . View a a replaces the target by |<MASK>| if m i ( a ) = 1 m_{i}^{(a)}=1 , giving w ( a ) = [ P , Y ~ ( a ) ] w^{(a)}=[P,\widetilde{Y}^{(a)}] . EOS is masked in both views. Images, prompts, headers, unsupervised turns, and empty thinking prefixes are not corrupted.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个响应块 b，采样 t_b ∼ 𝒰(0,1)。 在该块中，对于每个受监督的非 EOS 位置 i，抽取 m_i^{(1)} ∼ Bernoulli(t_b)，并设置 m_i^{(2)} = 1 − m_i^{(1)}。 在视图 a 中，如果 m_i^{(a)} = 1，则用 |<MASK>| 替换目标，得到 w^{(a)} = [P, \widetilde{Y}^{(a)}]。 EOS 在两个视图中都被掩码。 图像、提示、标题、无监督轮次以及空的思考前缀不会被损坏。

sents.en: For each response block b b , sample t b ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) t_{b}\sim\mathcal{U}(0,1) .
sents.zh: 对于每个响应块 b，采样 t_b ∼ 𝒰(0,1)。

sents.en: For every supervised non-EOS position i i in that block, draw m i ( 1 ) ∼ Bernoulli ⁡ ( t b ) m_{i}^{(1)}\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(t_{b}) and set m i ( 2 ) = 1 − m i ( 1 ) m_{i}^{(2)}=1-m_{i}^{(1)} .
sents.zh: 在该块中，对于每个受监督的非 EOS 位置 i，抽取 m_i^{(1)} ∼ Bernoulli(t_b)，并设置 m_i^{(2)} = 1 − m_i^{(1)}。

sents.en: View a a replaces the target by |<MASK>| if m i ( a ) = 1 m_{i}^{(a)}=1 , giving w ( a ) = [ P , Y ~ ( a ) ] w^{(a)}=[P,\widetilde{Y}^{(a)}] .
sents.zh: 在视图 a 中，如果 m_i^{(a)} = 1，则用 |<MASK>| 替换目标，得到 w^{(a)} = [P, \widetilde{Y}^{(a)}]。

sents.en: EOS is masked in both views.
sents.zh: EOS 在两个视图中都被掩码。

sents.en: Images, prompts, headers, unsupervised turns, and empty thinking prefixes are not corrupted.
sents.zh: 图像、提示、标题、无监督轮次以及空的思考前缀不会被损坏。

paragraphs.en: The joint input [ w ( 1 ) ; w ( 2 ) ; x ] [w^{(1)};w^{(2)};x] shares one clean multimodal stream and one visual encoding; each noisy view retains an uncorrupted prompt copy. Within a view, a noisy response block attends bidirectionally to itself and reads the clean visual/prompt context and strictly preceding clean response blocks. It cannot read current or future clean response targets or the other noisy view. Clean tokens use token-level causal attention and cannot attend to either noisy view. Figure 3 illustrates one view with two-token blocks for clarity.

paragraphs.en: RL is the final training phase for both variants, following coordinate alignment for GroundAnything-VLM and AR-to-Diffusion conversion for GroundAnything. GroundAnything uses causal attention for both rollout generation and likelihood evaluation. For each prompt, G = 8 G=8 responses are sampled at temperature T = 0.7 T=0.7 . Before updating, a no-gradient teacher-forcing pass records detached old-policy log-probabilities; a second pass computes current-policy gradients. Both use FP32 log-softmax at the rollout temperature. These are exact likelihoods of the causal policy, not likelihoods of a diffusion denoising trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: RL 是两种变体的最终训练阶段，在 GroundAnything-VLM 的坐标对齐和 GroundAnything 的 AR-to-Diffusion 转换之后进行。 GroundAnything 在 rollout 生成和似然评估中均使用因果注意力机制。 对于每个提示，以温度 T = 0.7 采样 G = 8 个响应。 在更新之前，一次无梯度的教师强制过程会记录脱离旧策略的对数概率；第二次过程则计算当前策略的梯度。 两者都在 rollout 温度下使用 FP32 对数 softmax。 这些是因果策略的确切似然，而非扩散去噪轨迹的似然。

paragraphs.en: Image/query prefill establishes a causal prefix cache and the first anchor token. A physical block contains this known anchor followed by B − 1 B-1 mask positions. Predictions retain the training token shift. Sub-blocks are completed from left to right; every denoising forward still evaluates the full physical block. Completed tokens remain visible to subsequent masked positions, and the prefix cache is reused throughout.

paragraphs.en: Bidirectional hidden states depend on positions to their right and cannot serve directly as causal history. After completing a block, one causal forward recomputes its authoritative KV entries and predicts the next anchor. This pass does not verify, reject, or replace the completed block. Thus, a block requiring D D denoising passes uses D + 1 D+1 NFEs, excluding initial prefill. The number of passes depends on commitment decisions rather than a fixed per-response denoising count.
paragraphs.zh: 双向隐藏状态依赖于其右侧的位置，因此不能直接作为因果历史使用。 完成一个区块后，一次因果前向计算会重新计算其权威 KV 条目，并预测下一个锚点。 此遍处理不会验证、拒绝或替换已完成的区块。 因此，需要 D 次去噪处理的区块会使用 D + 1 次 NFE，初始预填充除外。 处理遍数取决于提交决策，而非每次响应的固定去噪次数。

paragraphs.en: Dynamic Decoding uses a confidence threshold with a forced best-position fallback. Static Decoding commits the highest-confidence remaining positions under a prescribed per-pass quota, distributing the remaining positions across the remaining passes. These policies change token commitment, while preserving blockwise generation. They are distinct from AR verification; their confidence scores should not be identified with the unmodified-logit entropy used above.
paragraphs.zh: 动态解码使用一个置信度阈值，并带有强制最佳位置回退机制。 静态解码在每轮预定的配额下锁定置信度最高的剩余位置，并将剩余位置分配到剩下的轮次中。 这些策略会改变标记的锁定方式，同时保持按块生成的特性。 它们与 AR 验证不同；其置信度分数不应与上文使用的未修改对数概率熵混为一谈。

paragraphs.en: Self-speculative decoding ( Wu et al., 2026a ) uses GroundAnything’s shared weights for bidirectional drafting and causal verification, as illustrated in Figure 5 . Verification accepts only the longest consecutive draft prefix agreeing with the causal predictions. The first disagreement ends acceptance; later coincidental matches are discarded. Rejected suffix states are removed from the cache.
paragraphs.zh: 自我推测性解码（Wu 等人，2026a）利用 GroundAnything 的共享权重进行双向起草和因果验证，如图 5 所示。 验证过程仅接受与因果预测一致的最长连续草稿前缀。 首次出现不一致时即终止接受；后续偶然出现的匹配将被丢弃。 被拒绝的后缀状态将从缓存中移除。

sents.zh: 验证过程仅接受与因果预测一致的最长连续草稿前缀。

sents.en: The first disagreement ends acceptance; later coincidental matches are discarded.
sents.zh: 首次出现不一致时即终止接受；后续偶然出现的匹配将被丢弃。

sents.en: Rejected suffix states are removed from the cache.

paragraphs.en: Given a committed seed, a bidirectional pass predicts a candidate block, and a causal pass verifies it in parallel. Accepted draft tokens are committed with the verifier correction at the first mismatch. Each round uses two NFEs and 2 ​ B 2B query tokens. The seed is counted once and is excluded from draft-acceptance statistics.
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个已提交的种子，双向通路会预测一个候选块，而因果通路则并行地对其进行验证。 在首次出现不匹配时，已接受的草稿标记会与验证器的修正结果一同提交。 每一轮使用两次 NFE 和 2​ B 2B 查询标记。 种子仅计算一次，且不计入草稿接受统计中。

paragraphs.en: The implementation progresses from Native PyTorch (Eager) to SGLang (Eager), CUDA Graph replay, and selective FP8 execution. Denoising and causal passes retain their respective attention and cache semantics. FP8 applies to eligible language-model linear operations, with the remaining components kept in BF16. These changes reduce execution overhead or arithmetic cost; quantization can still alter logits and decoding decisions. The corresponding latency results are analyzed in Section 9.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 实现过程从原生 PyTorch（Eager）逐步演进到 SGLang（Eager）、CUDA Graph 重播以及选择性 FP8 执行。 去噪和因果处理流程各自保留其注意力机制和缓存的语义特性。 FP8 适用于符合条件的语言模型线性操作，其余组件则保持使用 BF16。 这些改动降低了执行开销或算术计算成本；但量化仍可能改变 logits 和解码决策。 相应的延迟结果在第 9.2 节中进行了分析。

sents.en: The corresponding latency results are analyzed in Section 9.2 .
sents.zh: 相应的延迟结果在第 9.2 节中进行了分析。

paragraphs.en: The drafters share visual preprocessing, the projector, coordinate vocabulary, serialization, and autoregressive backbone initialization. A single frozen causal branch of GroundAnything verifies all proposals. Adaptation matches ordered examples, supervised-token exposure, optimizer updates, effective batch size, and candidate-length sampling. These controls do not imply equal trainable parameter counts or training FLOPs.
paragraphs.zh: 设计者共享视觉预处理、投影器、坐标词汇表、序列化和自回归主干初始化。 GroundAnything 的一个冻结因果分支会验证所有提议。 自适应匹配有序示例、监督标记暴露、优化器更新、有效批量大小和候选长度采样。 这些控制并不意味着可训练参数数量或训练 FLOPs 相等。

paragraphs.en: The primary in-house MTP baseline uses a causal recurrent future-token module with weights shared across prediction horizons. It is distinct from LocateAnything, which uses bidirectional attention within box-aligned MTP blocks and autoregressive fallback in Hybrid Mode ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . An additional in-house block-MTP control predicts a fully masked candidate block in one bidirectional pass; it shares our data and token format but is not a reproduction of LocateAnything.
paragraphs.zh: 主要的内部 MTP 基线模型使用一个因果循环未来词元模块，其权重在预测时空中共享。 这与 LocateAnything 不同：后者在框对齐的 MTP 块内使用双向注意力，并在混合模式下采用自回归回退机制（Wang 等，2026）。 另一个内部块-MTP 控制模型通过一次双向处理预测一个完全掩码的候选块；它共享我们的数据和词元格式，但并非 LocateAnything 的复现。

paragraphs.en: The attention ablation compares separately trained causal and bidirectional DLMs with the same architecture, initialization, denoising objective, corruption distribution, training exposure, and refinement schedule. Only candidate-block attention differs during training and inference. All candidate positions can read the committed prefix; the prefix cannot read candidates. This pair isolates attention, whereas comparing block MTP with DLM also changes the objective and refinement procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 注意力消融实验将分别训练的因果和双向 DLM 进行了比较，这些模型具有相同的架构、初始化、去噪目标、损坏分布、训练暴露度和优化计划。 在训练和推理过程中，唯一不同的是候选块注意力机制。 所有候选位置都可以读取已确定的前缀；而前缀无法读取候选内容。 这对实验隔离了注意力机制的影响，而将块 MTP 与 DLM 进行比较则会同时改变目标函数和优化流程。

paragraphs.en: At K = 16 K=16 , one-step DLM accepts 21.76% of candidates (3.48 tokens per round), compared with 16.81% (2.69 tokens) for causal MTP. This reduces c A c_{A} from 7.71 to 5.38 ms, a 30.2% reduction at matched candidate length. Across the tested lengths, DLM’s lowest cost is 5.38 ms at K = 16 K=16 , while MTP’s is 6.58 ms at K = 8 K=8 . However, MTP is preferable at K = 4 K=4 : its cost is 7.15 ms versus 9.31 ms for DLM. At K = 32 K=32 , DLM’s accepted prefix decreases to 3.30 tokens despite the longer proposal. These results favor selecting candidate length by accepted work and elapsed time rather than nominal parallelism.
paragraphs.zh: 在 K = 16 K=16 时，单步 DLM 接受 21.76% 的候选项（每轮 3.48 个词元），而因果 MTP 的接受率为 16.81%（2.69 个词元）。 这使得 c A c_{A} 从 7.71 降低到 5.38 毫秒，在候选项长度匹配的情况下减少了 30.2%。 在所有测试的长度中，DLM 的最低成本为 K = 16 K=16 时的 5.38 毫秒，而 MTP 的最低成本为 K = 8 K=8 时的 6.58 毫秒。 然而，在 K = 4 K=4 时，MTP 更优：其成本为 7.15 毫秒，而 DLM 的成本为 9.31 毫秒。 在 K = 32 K=32 时，尽管提案更长，DLM 接受的词元前缀减少到了 3.30 个。 这些结果表明，选择候选项长度时应优先考虑已接受的工作量和实际耗时，而非名义上的并行性。

paragraphs.en: This measures progress at equal elapsed time, counting verifier corrections and bonuses.
paragraphs.zh: 该指标在相同经过时间上衡量进展，同时计入验证器的修正和奖励。

paragraphs.en: At K = 16 K=16 , two DLM passes reduce c A c_{A} from 5.38 to 4.70 ms, whereas four and eight passes increase it to 6.84 and 11.83 ms. Cost per committed output token decreases by only 3.8%, because the verifier contributes a correction or bonus token in each full round. At 400 ms, DLM commits 97.1 tokens versus 84.6 for MTP; at 50 ms, MTP leads with 10.6 versus 8.6. Thus, refinement is beneficial over part of the latency range, but additional passes and very short budgets can reverse the advantage.
paragraphs.zh: 在 K = 16 时，两次 DLM 处理将 c A c_{A} 从 5.38 降低至 4.70 ms，而四次和八次处理则将其增至 6.84 和 11.83 ms。 每个已提交的输出标记的成本仅降低了 3.8%，因为验证器在每一轮完整处理中都会贡献一个修正或奖励标记。 在 400 ms 时，DLM 提交了 97.1 个标记，而 MTP 为 84.6 个；在 50 ms 时，MTP 以 10.6 比 8.6 领先。 因此，在部分延迟范围内，优化是有益的，但增加处理次数和采用极短的时间预算可能会使这种优势逆转。

paragraphs.en: Each drafter receives the same diagnostic windows: category transitions from COCO, crowded objects from Dense200, document regions from DocLayNet, and GUI targets from ScreenSpot-Pro. Candidate length is matched, both DLM variants use two refinement steps, and the bidirectional block-MTP control uses one pass. Diagnostic windows are selected from the common reference serialization before inspecting proposals. Raw format error detects illegal structural transitions, token types, or coordinate arity, using the parser state inherited from the prefix. Ending partway through an otherwise valid tuple at the candidate boundary is not itself a format error. Diagnostics precede grammar filtering, fallback, and verification.
paragraphs.zh: 每个起草者都接收到相同的诊断窗口：类别转换来自 COCO、密集物体来自 Dense200、文档区域来自 DocLayNet，以及 GUI 目标来自 ScreenSpot-Pro。 候选长度相匹配，两种 DLM 变体均使用两个优化步骤，而双向块-MTP 控制则使用一次遍历。 在检查提案之前，诊断窗口会从共同的参考序列化中选择。 原始格式错误检测会识别非法的结构转换、标记类型或坐标元数，并使用从前缀继承的解析器状态。 在候选边界处提前结束一个原本有效的元组本身并不构成格式错误。 诊断操作优先于语法过滤、回退和验证。

sents.zh: 在候选边界处提前结束一个原本有效的元组本身并不构成格式错误。

paragraphs.en: Matching is one-to-one against relevant remaining references, constrained by category or referring target and IoU at least 0.5. Unmatched duplicates, reversed corners, and zero-area boxes count as geometric misses. The numerator counts unmatched complete, syntactically valid proposed boxes; the denominator counts all complete, syntactically valid proposed boxes. The rate is undefined when this denominator is zero. It measures the fraction of eligible proposals that remain unmatched and is interpreted alongside format errors; it is not a ground-truth miss rate.
paragraphs.zh: 匹配在相关剩余参考项中是一对一的，受类别或引用目标以及至少为 0.5 的 IoU 约束。 未匹配的重复项、反向角点以及面积为零的框被视为几何性失配。 分子统计未匹配的完整且语法正确的提议框；分母统计所有完整且语法正确的提议框。 当该分母为零时，该比率无定义。 它衡量合格提议中仍保持未匹配的比例，并与格式错误一同进行解释；它并非真实值失配率。

paragraphs.en: Verifier agreement, structural validity, and geometric accuracy measure different properties. Exact greedy verification produces the same sequence as the shared causal verifier; a finite deadline can yield different-length prefixes of that sequence. These diagnostics therefore assess draft reliability and rejected computation, rather than improved final localization under a fixed exact verifier.
paragraphs.zh: 验证器一致性、结构有效性和几何精度分别衡量不同的属性。 精确贪心验证生成的序列与共享因果验证器相同；有限的截止日期可能会产生该序列长度不同的前缀。 因此，这些诊断方法评估的是草案可靠性和被拒绝的计算过程，而非在固定精确验证器下最终定位的改进效果。

sents.zh: 验证器一致性、结构有效性和几何精度分别衡量不同的属性。

paragraphs.en: Relative to causal MTP, bidirectional DLM reduces COCO format errors from 5.01% to 1.80%. Its valid-box miss rate decreases by 10.10 pp on Dense200 and 7.52 pp on DocLayNet, compared with only 0.46 pp on GUI. These differences are consistent with greater benefits for proposals containing several spatially related elements. The retrained DLM pair provides the attention control: bidirectional attention lowers the Dense200 rate from 21.74% to 14.79% at the same refinement depth. Bidirectional block-MTP also improves over causal MTP, so bidirectionality itself is not a uniquely diffusion-based advantage. Its one-pass comparison with two-step DLM changes objective and refinement cost; it does not isolate diffusion training at equal elapsed time. The separate deadline analysis provides the matched-time comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 与因果 MTP 相比，双向 DLM 将 COCO 格式错误率从 5.01% 降低至 1.80%。 与 GUI 上仅减少 0.46 pp 相比，其在 Dense200 上的有效框漏检率下降了 10.10 pp，在 DocLayNet 上下降了 7.52 pp。 这些差异与包含多个空间相关元素的提案所能获得的更大收益一致。 重新训练的 DLM 对提供了注意力控制：在相同的细化深度下，双向注意力将 Dense200 的错误率从 21.74% 降低至 14.79%。 双向块-MTP 也优于因果 MTP，因此双向性本身并非扩散模型独有的优势。 其单步处理与两步 DLM 的比较改变了目标函数和细化成本；在相同经过时间下，它并未单独隔离扩散训练的影响。 独立的截止时间分析提供了匹配时间的比较结果。

paragraphs.en: Together, the acceptance, cost, and deadline results support Finding 2.2 : bidirectional diffusion with limited refinement makes draft generation more efficient than the tested causal MTP baseline over the reported operating range. The attention control supports joint access to visual evidence, while the refinement sweep identifies when an additional denoising pass repays its cost; neither establishes superiority over every MTP design. The geometric diagnostic measures proposal reliability before verification, separately from ScreenSpot accuracy, F1mIoU, and ground-truth recall. Exact verification preserves the shared causal model’s completed output.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，接受度、成本和截止时间的结果支持发现 2.2：在有限的优化条件下，双向扩散在报告的操作范围内比所测试的因果 MTP 基线能更高效地生成初稿。 注意力控制支持对视觉证据的联合访问，而优化扫描则用于判断何时执行额外的去噪步骤能够抵消其成本；但这两种机制都无法证明其优于所有 MTP 设计。 几何诊断指标在验证前即能衡量提案的可靠性，且该可靠性与 ScreenSpot 准确率、F1mIoU 和真实值召回率相互独立。 精确验证保留了共享因果模型所完成的输出结果。

sents.en: Exact verification preserves the shared causal model’s completed output.
sents.zh: 精确验证保留了共享因果模型所完成的输出结果。

paragraphs.en: TPF denotes committed output tokens per model forward; TPS denotes output tokens per second. Forward counts must include the causal cache-construction or verification passes required by the relevant schedule. The physical block size B B in the decoding sweeps includes the known anchor, whereas candidate length K K in the DLM–MTP comparison counts newly proposed tokens. The two quantities should not be identified. All quality values in the decoding sweeps are COCO F1mIoU, and their speed–accuracy trade-offs should not be extrapolated to a 30-benchmark quality average.
paragraphs.zh: TPF 表示每次模型前向传播所承诺的输出标记数；TPS 表示每秒的输出标记数。 前向传播次数必须包含相关调度方案所要求的因果缓存构建或验证步骤。 解码轮次中的物理块大小 B B 包含已知的锚点，而 DLM–MTP 比较中的候选长度 K K 则计算新提出的标记。 这两个量不应被等同看待。 解码轮次中的所有质量值均为 COCO F1mIoU，其速度–准确性权衡不应外推至 30 个基准测试的质量平均值。

sents.zh: TPF 表示每次模型前向传播所承诺的输出标记数；TPS 表示每秒的输出标记数。

paragraphs.en: The AR reference is 49.6 TPS with 63.70 F1mIoU. At B = 32 B=32 , throughput is 223.8 TPS for linear self-speculation, 49.9 TPS for quadratic self-speculation, and 127.0 TPS for entropy guidance at τ = 0.8 \tau=0.8 . The corresponding COCO quality is 62.96 for linear self-speculation and 60.72 for entropy guidance. Thus, the two main speedups are 223.8 / 49.6 = 4.51 × 223.8/49.6=4.51\times and 127.0 / 49.6 = 2.56 × 127.0/49.6=2.56\times , with quality gaps of 0.74 and 2.98 pp.
paragraphs.zh: AR参考值为49.6 TPS，F1mIoU为63.70。 在B = 32 B=32时，线性自推测的吞吐量为223.8 TPS，二次自推测为49.9 TPS，而τ = 0.8 \tau=0.8时的熵引导为127.0 TPS。 对应的COCO质量分别为：线性自推测为62.96，熵引导为60.72。 因此，两种主要加速比为223.8 / 49.6 = 4.51 × 223.8/49.6=4.51\times和127.0 / 49.6 = 2.56 × 127.0/49.6=2.56\times，质量差距分别为0.74和2.98 pp。

sents.en: The AR reference is 49.6 TPS with 63.70 F1mIoU.
sents.zh: AR参考值为49.6 TPS，F1mIoU为63.70。

sents.en: At B = 32 B=32 , throughput is 223.8 TPS for linear self-speculation, 49.9 TPS for quadratic self-speculation, and 127.0 TPS for entropy guidance at τ = 0.8 \tau=0.8 .
sents.zh: 在B = 32 B=32时，线性自推测的吞吐量为223.8 TPS，二次自推测为49.9 TPS，而τ = 0.8 \tau=0.8时的熵引导为127.0 TPS。

sents.en: Thus, the two main speedups are 223.8 / 49.6 = 4.51 × 223.8/49.6=4.51\times and 127.0 / 49.6 = 2.56 × 127.0/49.6=2.56\times , with quality gaps of 0.74 and 2.98 pp.

paragraphs.en: Linear TPF rises from 1.41 at B = 4 B=4 to 2.21 at B = 16 B=16 , then changes little at B = 32 B=32 (2.18). Quadratic TPF reaches 3.17 at both B = 16 B=16 and B = 32 B=32 . At B = 32 B=32 , its 45.4% higher TPF nevertheless accompanies much lower TPS than the linear schedule. Fusing verification and proposal reduces forward-call count but increases the number of query tokens, illustrating why TPF alone is not a latency metric. From B = 16 B=16 to B = 32 B=32 , linear throughput changes from 226.6 to 223.8 TPS, whereas quadratic throughput falls from 88.0 to 49.9 TPS.
paragraphs.zh: 线性 TPF 在 B = 4 B=4 时从 1.41 上升到 B = 16 B=16 时的 2.21，之后在 B = 32 B=32 时变化不大（2.18）。 二次 TPF 在 B = 16 B=16 和 B = 32 B=32 时均达到 3.17。 在 B = 32 B=32 时，其 TPF 虽然高出 45.4%，但 TPS 却远低于线性调度方案。 将验证与提议融合可以减少前向调用次数，但会增加查询令牌的数量，这说明了为何仅凭 TPF 无法作为延迟指标。 从 B = 16 B=16 到 B = 32 B=32，线性吞吐量从 226.6 变为 223.8 TPS，而二次吞吐量则从 88.0 下降到 49.9 TPS。

sents.en: Linear TPF rises from 1.41 at B = 4 B=4 to 2.21 at B = 16 B=16 , then changes little at B = 32 B=32 (2.18).
sents.zh: 线性 TPF 在 B = 4 B=4 时从 1.41 上升到 B = 16 B=16 时的 2.21，之后在 B = 32 B=32 时变化不大（2.18）。

sents.en: Quadratic TPF reaches 3.17 at both B = 16 B=16 and B = 32 B=32 .
sents.zh: 二次 TPF 在 B = 16 B=16 和 B = 32 B=32 时均达到 3.17。

sents.en: At B = 32 B=32 , its 45.4% higher TPF nevertheless accompanies much lower TPS than the linear schedule.
sents.zh: 在 B = 32 B=32 时，其 TPF 虽然高出 45.4%，但 TPS 却远低于线性调度方案。

sents.en: Fusing verification and proposal reduces forward-call count but increases the number of query tokens, illustrating why TPF alone is not a latency metric.
sents.zh: 将验证与提议融合可以减少前向调用次数，但会增加查询令牌的数量，这说明了为何仅凭 TPF 无法作为延迟指标。

sents.en: From B = 16 B=16 to B = 32 B=32 , linear throughput changes from 226.6 to 223.8 TPS, whereas quadratic throughput falls from 88.0 to 49.9 TPS.
sents.zh: 从 B = 16 B=16 到 B = 32 B=32，线性吞吐量从 226.6 变为 223.8 TPS，而二次吞吐量则从 88.0 下降到 49.9 TPS。

paragraphs.en: As τ \tau increases from 0.2 to 1.2, TPF increases from 1.02 to 1.60 and TPS from 107.3 to 148.7. COCO F1mIoU remains near 60 for τ ≤ 0.8 \tau\leq 0.8 , peaks at 60.72 at τ = 0.8 \tau=0.8 , falls to 54.06 at τ = 1.0 \tau=1.0 , and partly recovers to 56.14 at τ = 1.2 \tau=1.2 . The non-monotonic quality curve supports a speed–accuracy trade-off rather than a universal monotonic accuracy law. Increasing τ \tau permits more uncertain tokens to be committed together; the observed quality drop is consistent with the risk of premature commitment.
paragraphs.zh: 随着 τ 从 0.2 增加到 1.2，TPF 从 1.02 增加到 1.60，TPS 则从 107.3 增加到 148.7。 当 τ ≤ 0.8 时，COCO F1mIoU 保持在 60 附近；在 τ = 0.8 时达到峰值 60.72；在 τ = 1.0 时降至 54.06；并在 τ = 1.2 时部分恢复至 56.14。 这种非单调的质量曲线支持速度与准确性的权衡，而非一种普适的单调准确性定律。 增大 τ 允许更多不确定的标记被同时确定；观察到的质量下降与过早确定的风险一致。

paragraphs.en: Entropy-guided TPF changes only from 1.18 to 1.24 over the tested block sizes, while its best COCO score is 61.58 at B = 16 B=16 . Linear self-speculation attains its best tested COCO score at B = 32 B=32 . Consequently, the B = 32 B=32 operating point used for the headline comparison is not the maximum-quality choice for every decoding strategy. Block-size selection therefore depends on task quality and output length; the COCO sweep alone does not establish a universal optimum.
paragraphs.zh: 在测试的块大小范围内，熵引导 TPF 的变化仅从 1.18 变为 1.24，而其在 B = 16 时的最佳 COCO 分数为 61.58。 线性自推测在 B = 32 时达到了测试中的最佳 COCO 分数。 因此，用于主要比较的 B = 32 操作点并非所有解码策略中质量最高的选择。 因此，块大小的选择取决于任务质量和输出长度；仅凭 COCO 扫描无法确定通用的最优值。

paragraphs.en: Self-speculation verifies against the converted model’s causal branch. Exact greedy verification preserves that branch’s outputs, not necessarily the outputs of the separately trained GroundAnything-VLM. The 0.74 pp gap to GroundAnything-VLM therefore does not imply that the verifier accepts mismatching tokens. Direct entropy-guided decoding has no AR acceptance test and remains the appropriate main-table setting for assessing diffusion generation itself.
paragraphs.zh: 自我推测会与转换后模型的因果分支进行验证。 精确的贪心验证会保留该分支的输出，但不一定包括单独训练的 GroundAnything-VLM 的输出。 因此，与 GroundAnything-VLM 相比存在 0.74 pp 的差距，并不意味着验证器会接受不匹配的标记。 直接由熵引导的解码没有 AR 接受测试，并且仍然是评估扩散生成本身时合适的表设置。

sents.zh: 自我推测会与转换后模型的因果分支进行验证。

sents.en: Exact greedy verification preserves that branch’s outputs, not necessarily the outputs of the separately trained GroundAnything-VLM.
